name: Experts
description: Agents as expert people: each one has a name, a specialty, knowledge, its own tools and a live panel. You can talk to them directly and Nuxiva hands them the questions in their field.
capabilities: Experts with name, role, specialty and knowledge
Tools assigned to each expert, with the same safety confirmations
Live panel with the expert's real data and what it is doing
"Ask the expert" chat with encrypted history
Nuxiva routes questions to the right expert and can create new ones

debian.name: Mark
debian.specialty: Debian, systemd services, apt packages, logs and server performance
knowledge: Package management with apt and dpkg, security updates
systemd services: status, startup, errors and dependencies
Reading logs with journalctl and troubleshooting
Disk space, memory, load and temperature
